newsitem.title: GREECE: BASKETBALL-PANATHINAIKOS RECOVER TO BEAT PAU 75-71.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-PANATHINAIKOS RECOVER TO BEAT PAU 75-71.

text.p: Holders Panathinaikos recovered in the second half to beat Pau Orthez 75-71 in a group F European basketball league qualifier on Wednesday, forcing the French out of the last 16 clubs in the competition.

Injury striken Orthez put up a heroic effort playing with only six players throughout and leading until the last minute after a splendid performance in the first half when they were ahead by 10 points (41-31).
But with 30 seconds left and Pau ahead 71-70, Panathinaikos American playmaker Byron Dinkins (15 points) notched a tripple to put the Greeks in control.
Orthez missed the fast break and fouled giving Panathinaikos' forward Julius Nuosou two successful free throws for the final 75-71.
The French, who left back home their two top stars Antoine Rigodo and Lorens Fandeberg, had youngster Fabien Doubos top- scoring with 20 points and Thiery Gadou with 19.
Panathinaikos finished the second round first in their group and will have a home advantage in the playoffs.
